champion.title: segment as index plays solar installers
champion.pitch: a manual business process -> an agent that completes it end to end. For solar rooftop installers: Every visual region is a queryable address; ask 'what changed in region 3 since Tuesday' and the segmentation index answers with receipts. Orchestration: hierarchical crew — team leads own subgoals; workers own steps; escalation is explicit. Stack: Muse Spark + Muse Glimmer + Muse Wonder + Muse Voice.

finalists8.title: construction QA, mixture of world agents edition
finalists8.pitch: methods section -> runnable recipe (env, seeds, compute) with missing steps flagged. Built for construction QA crews — fixes: reproducing a paper costs weeks and usually fails quietly. Several world-model agents each simulate a different version of how the environment will respond; a gating router picks the rollout that best matches live evidence before any action is taken. Orchestration: speculative race (parallel attempts with early exit on consensus). Stack: Muse Wonder + Muse Spark + SAM 3.1

finalists8.title: segment as index take on vocational institutes

For vocational training institutes: Every visual region is a queryable address; ask 'what changed in region 3 since Tuesday' and the segmentation index answers with receipts. Orchestration: tool forge loop — the agent extends its own toolset mid-task when gaps appear. Stack: Muse Wonder + SAM 3.1 + Muse Spark + Muse Spark Open (open weights).

finalists8.title: research freelancers via segment as index
finalists8.pitch: pick the minimal frame set that preserves label quality — 10× cheaper annotation with a quality guarantee. Built for research-engineering freelancers — fixes: nobody can release a video dataset without a license audit. Every visual region is a queryable address; ask 'what changed in region 3 since Tuesday' and the segmentation index answers with receipts. Orchestration: tool forge loop (the agent extends its own toolset mid-task when gaps appear). Stack: SAM 3.1 + Muse Spark Open (open weights)

finalists8.title: The tape session every packaging lines never had · mixture of role based experts
finalists8.pitch: amateur game/practice footage -> a pro-grade structured insight report. For packaging line supervisors: A standing cast of role experts — planner, skeptic, executor, auditor, historian — with a gate that routes each decision to the cheapest expert who can answer with attached evidence. Orchestration: supervisor swarm — one supervisor fans work out to a parallel swarm and merges results. Stack: SAM 3.1 + Muse Wonder + Muse Spark + Muse Spark Open (open weights).
